Learning by doing

Growing curiosity and knowledge.

Gardening, poultry keeping and age-appropriate introductions to practical skills.

04

The need

Gardening and poultry keeping are described as learning activities. Tools, seeds, protective fencing and watering equipment are among the identified needs.

The proposed response

Develop small, self-contained learning projects. Each activity must be supervised, age-appropriate and supported by a maintenance plan. No sales income is assumed.

Next steps

  1. 01

    Review equipment and available space

  2. 02

    Plan activities with the teachers

  3. 03

    Provide equipment and monitor learning

Who will benefit?

The Beog-Zaadba school community. Scope and beneficiary numbers will be approved for each stage before launch.
